input.objective: Create a polished, genuinely watchable 40 to 44 second launch film for The Hooks Store, https://the-hooks-store.sites.imd.fun, a storefront where anyone builds a Uniswap v4 hook from blocks and launches it through IMD's swarm. Deliver the finished MP4, 1920x1080, 30 fps, H.264 with AAC audio, made for X, plus a 1920x1080 poster frame. STYLE, the most important instruction: a clean, light, high-end software launch film in the manner of the best product videos on X (Linear, Vercel, Raycast launches): a near-white background with soft drifting colour glows; very large kinetic typography in a modern grotesk (Geist, weights 600 to 800, tight letter-spacing) that fills the frame and animates in word by word with expo easing; glassy rounded tiles with soft shadows floating in shallow 3D space, slightly blurred when far; a pill with a rotating gradient edge and a light streak; real-looking user-interface mockups of the store with depth and soft shadows; one elegant chart with gradient strokes drawing on; fast, smooth, confident cuts; no pixel art in the motion design except the store's small pixel wordmark at the end. Reference feel: a 42 second product video where big black type on white alternates with floating app tiles and a glass 'Routing…' pill. Everything must read with sound off: short lines held long enough to read. MUSIC, the most important instruction after style: the soundtrack must be the actual commercial recording of Drake's song 'Nonstop' (Scorpion, 2018, Republic Records), trimmed to the video length and mixed under the picture; do not substitute a sound-alike, a generated track or library music. If you cannot obtain and legally use that recording, say so in README.md and stop. A few soft interface sounds; absolutely no voiceover, narration or text-to-speech. Avoid stock footage, generic crypto imagery, rockets, price charts, mascots, people, flashing effects and tiny captions. WHAT IT IS, in the store's own words: stack blocks (Swap fee, Pause switch, Cooldown, Allowlist opening, Buyback jar, Anti-sniper window and more), the Builder turns every block into an exact sentence the swarm receives, IMD's swarm writes, tests and audits the hook with four auditors and a judge, then deploys it, usually in 30 to 90 minutes, for 0.5 IMD once; the hook gets its own page with its addresses and owner controls; a creator can feature a hook on the store for 0.1 IMD per 24 hours. BRAND AND SOURCES: palette paper #faf7f0, ink #15130f, pine #1f4d3a, mint #9fd8b8, gold #d9a834, coral #e07a5f used only in gradients; fonts Geist and Geist Mono (Google Fonts); the store's pixel wordmark is Press Start 2P 'THE HOOKS STORE' beside a drawn fishing hook, used once at the end. Inspect the live site for the Builder, a hook page (https://the-hooks-store.sites.imd.fun/#hook/1/0xbe2a3bbe001cb0aa2fd3dafd7260eb579e10d948aad6aa62c80717ed5c0adf1c) and the featured strip; rebuild their interface as clean mockups, do not screen-record. Download assets into the workspace first; media commands use local relative paths. Do not connect a wallet or send any transaction. STORYBOARD (refine pacing and wording, keep the facts): 0-4s a glass pill 'Casting…' with a gradient edge and an orbiting light streak opens into the huge title 'The Hooks Store' and the line 'Uniswap v4 hooks, built from blocks.' 4-10s kinetic type: 'Hooks are code.' then in grey 'You don't have to write it.' 10-18s six glass block tiles (Swap fee, Pause switch, Cooldown, Allowlist, Buyback jar, Anti-sniper) float in 3D and three of them stack; a hook card mockup fills in row by row; the exact-text sheet appears with two sentences highlighted; lines 'Stack blocks.' and 'Every block becomes an exact sentence the swarm receives.' 18-26s 'Written. Tested. Audited.' then 'Then deployed.' in pine; five glass nodes (Write, Test, Audit ×4, Judge, Deploy) light up along a progress line; the stat '0.5 IMD, once, audit included.' 26-32s 'From idea to live hook: weeks of Solidity, usually under two hours.' with a chart of two gradient curves and the stats 'weeks' and '30–90 minutes'. 32-37s the live hook page mockup: the Live pill, addresses typing in, the owner controls with Pause swaps; the line 'Your hook. Live. With its own controls.'; then the featured strip of #AD pills sliding by. 37-44s the pixel wordmark, 'Cast yours.' in huge type, the URL the-hooks-store.sites.imd.fun held for three seconds. GUARDRAILS: no claims beyond those facts; no 'safe', 'guaranteed', 'risk-free' or returns; no other projects, tokens or logos; no price of IMD. Deliver artifacts/hooks-store-launch.mp4 and artifacts/poster.png, plus README.md with production notes, tools used, music source and licence, and what you could not do.
